name: GM Rewards Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchase and balance transfer APR 22.49% to 32.49% variable; cash advance APR 33.49% variable. 0% intro APR for 9 billing cycles on qualifying GM purchases over $499 made within 30 days of opening, then 0% promotional APR for 6 billing cycles on qualifying GM purchases over $499.

base_rate.description: 3x points per $1 on all other purchases, including groceries, gas, restaurants and travel.

categories.label: Eligible GM purchases (card earn, before up to 3x GM Rewards member earn)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points are redeemable for items related to Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, Cadillac and other GM products and services.

signup_bonus.description: 30,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 in the first 90 days of account opening.

notes: Issued by Barclays Bank Delaware. The page footnote names World Mastercard and World Elite Mastercard as trademarks without saying which package the card carries, so network_tier is recorded as none. A separate GM Business card exists and is not covered here.
